rationale: The only substantive ground-truth concern (yenuo26's inline note about verifying reduce_scatter in the test) is touched on tangentially by X's minor comment on the test-fake scaffolding, while Y never raises it at all and instead affirmatively validates the reduce_scatter/device_communicator premise without flagging any test gap. X also surfaces a specific, well-evidenced, actionable major concern (vllm_parallel_state._DP potentially aliasing the diffusion coordinator outside the use_moe_parallel_mapping branch, causing an unguarded all_gather_object) with concrete file/line directives and a proposed test, whereas Y's APPROVE verdict examines a narrower case (tp2_sp2, world_size==1) and misses the broader scenario X raises, making its confident approval riskier if X's claim holds. Y is cleaner and every claim it does make is grounded, but its low finding count and higher-level 'PASS' scan yield much lower recall and actionability than X's directive-driven review.
